_s215b_slots_basis: LivingEntity getArmorSlots / getHandSlots / getArmorAndBodyArmorSlots / getAllSlots (class_1309 method_5661 / 5877 / 56674 / 56675), gone in 1.21.5 (EntityEquipment), restored on LivingEntity by mixin/CbEntitySlotsRestoredMixin as views over getItemBySlot / setItemSlot (rt/CbEntitySlots).
